# pi-glance 0.6.0

A Pi 0.84 compatibility and session-facts release, with light/dark Glance themes and settled Model speed.

## Highlights

- Updated the development and CI baseline to Pi 0.84.2 and Node 22.19+.
- Added light/dark Glance theme pairs while preserving all 22 built-in palettes.
- Made adaptive width fitting always on and migrated config to schema v7.
- Added aggregate cache hit rate (`CH%`) and complete billed-session Tokens/Cost accounting across assistant, tool, compaction, and branch-summary usage.
- Switched Context to Pi's public `ctx.getContextUsage()` facts.
- Added settled Model speed based on provider output minus reported reasoning over active text/tool-call stream time, finalized at `agent_settled`.
- Improved Pi 0.84 narrow editor framing, autocomplete, history keybindings, CJK/emoji rendering, and regular/fullscreen behavior.
- Removed the unused speculative Pi token-style adapter seam.

## Community contributions

Special thanks to:

- [@Ambiel127](https://github.com/Ambiel127) for [PR #4](https://github.com/LinYS77/pi-glance/pull/4), which introduced the cache hit-rate (`CH%`) direction.
- [@luluyuu](https://github.com/luluyuu) for [PR #5](https://github.com/LinYS77/pi-glance/pull/5), which introduced the model generation-speed direction integrated and hardened in this release.

## Compatibility notes

- Pi exposes one custom-editor slot, so custom editor extensions remain last-writer-wins by load order.
- Pi fullscreen currently reserves one footer dock row even when pi-glance renders no footer content.
